knowledge:
- key_parameters: methData=The real control dataset used to generate the synthetic chromosome ;; nbBlock=The number of blocks randomly selected in the real dataset genome ;; nbCpG=The number of consecutive methylated sites that must contain each selected block ;; nbGeneration=The number of generations to simulate (at least 2) ;; vNbSample=Vector of the number of controls/cases in each simulation ;; vpDiff=Mean proportion of samples with differentially methylated values ;; vDiff=The shift of the mean of the C/T ratio in the differentially methylated sites ;; vInheritance=The proportion of cases that inherit differentially methylated sites ;; propInherite=The proportion of differentially methylated regions that are inherited ;; rateDiff=The mean frequency of the differentially methylated regions ;; runAnalysis=Logical indicating whether to run differential methylation analysis using methylKit
- alternatives: methylInheritance package (used to evaluate the power and false discovery rate of the experiment design using the generated datasets)
- when_to_use: When simulating multigenerational or transgenerational DNA methylation datasets to evaluate the statistical power and false discovery rate of experimental designs, or to benchmark inheritance detection software.
- pitfalls: At least 2 generations must be present (nbGeneration >= 2). The input methData must contain control samples with coverage, Cs, and Ts (e.g., formatted as a methylBase object). If keepDiff = FALSE, the differentially methylated sites are identical across all simulations.

workflows.name: multigenerational_methylation_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate a multigeneration methylation case-control experiment with inheritance using a real control dataset.
input: samplesForChrSynthetic (A real control dataset containing methylation coverage, Cs, and Ts formatted as a methylBase object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the real control dataset ;; 2. Run the simulation using runSim to generate synthetic chromosomes, control/case datasets, and inheritance patterns ;; 3. Verify the generated files in the output directory
workflows.code:
data(samplesForChrSynthetic)
head(samplesForChrSynthetic, n = 3)
temp_dir <- "test_runSim"
runSim(methData = samplesForChrSynthetic, # The dataset use for generate 
                                           # the synthetic chr.
        nbSynCHR = 1,       # The number of synthetic chromosome
        nbSimulation = 2,   # The number of simulation for each parameter
        nbBlock = 10, nbCpG = 20, # The number of site in the 
                                  # synthetic chr is nbBLock * nbCpG
        nbGeneration = 3,    # At least 2 generations must be present
        vNbSample = c(3, 6), # The number of controls (= number of cases) in
                             # each simulation
        vpDiff = c(0.9),   # Mean proportion of samples with  
                           # differentially methylated values
        vpDiffsd = c(0.1), # Standard deviation associated to vpDiff
        vDiff = c(0.8),    # The shift of the mean of the C/T ratio in 
                           # the differentially methylated sites
        vInheritance = c(0.5),  # The proportion of cases that inherit 
                                # differentially methylated sites
        propInherite = 0.3,     # The proportion of diffementially methylated
                                # regions that are inherited
        rateDiff = 0.3,    # The mean frequency of the differentially 
                           # methylated regions
        minRate = 0.2,     # The minimum rate for differentially
                           # methylated sites
        propHetero = 0.5,  # The reduction of vDiff for the following
                           # generations
        keepDiff = FALSE,  # When FALSE, the differentially methylated
                           # sites are the same in all simulations
        outputDir = temp_dir, # Directory where files are saved
        fileID = "S1",
        runAnalysis = TRUE, 
        nbCores = 1, 
        vSeed = 32)
dir(temp_dir)
